subject: Architecture review: align engineering owners and schedule room
messages:
From: Joe Summers <joe.summers@medixhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: proposed architecture review and stakeholders

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the discovery call earlier — good to meet the team. A quick recap from our side: Medix is exploring an inference platform to standardize model serving across our multi-cloud footprint. We want to validate latency and cost assumptions, and ensure the platform fits our security/KMS requirements.

Next step for us is a focused architecture review with our platform and security leads. Ideally this would be a 60-minute session where your engineering team can walk through: routing/fallbacks, dedicated vs private deployment options, KV cache behavior, and example perf numbers for 2k token sequences.

Can you confirm who from your engineering org should attend? We’d like at minimum: someone who owns the serving runtime and one person for security/compliance questions.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Sep 16: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu Sep 17: 09:00–10:00

Attendees from Medix so far: Joe Summers (me, Platform), Priya Singh (Infra), plus likely Ben Chen (Security). I’ll confirm Ben after internal sync but trying to lock a time now.

I’ve attached our platform questionnaire and a short list of priority topics to the email for reference. Can you send a calendar invite (Zoom or Meet) once we lock the slot and include a short agenda?

Thanks,
Joe
Head of Platform, Medix Health
joe.summers@medixhealth.com

Attachment: Medix-platform-questions.docx (DOCX, 42KB)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Joe Summers <joe.summers@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposed architecture review and stakeholders

Hi Joe — great to meet you as well. Appreciate the clear priorities.

Quick answers: Karthik will own the runtime deep-dive and can walk through kernel selection/batching and fallback policies. Marissa will cover deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and cost/SLAs. I’ll join to coordinate the agenda and notes.

Both times on Wed (10:00 or 14:00 PT) work for us; Thu morning is also fine if that ends up being easier for your team. If you can confirm a preferred slot I’ll send a calendar invite.

Draft agenda (60m):
- 5m: Introductions & desired outcomes
- 20m: Serving runtime architecture + perf profiles (Karthik)
- 15m: Deployment and security considerations (Marissa)
- 15m: Q&A and next steps (all)
- 5m: Owner assignments / mutual action plan

I’m attaching a short one-pager that maps our topics to the agenda so folks can pre-read.

Options for the meeting room — preference? We can send Zoom (password-protected) or Google Meet. We’ll include an agenda doc in the invite.

Cheers,
Lukas
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-arch-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

Thanks — Wed Sep 16 14:00 PT works best for us.

Confirmed Medix attendees: Joe Summers (Platform), Priya Singh (Infra), Ben Chen (Security), Sofia Lopez (SRE) — Ben will join except in case of last-minute conflict.

Zoom is preferable for our broader team (we have external compliance constraints). If you can send a password-protected Zoom invite with the agenda, that would be ideal. Also, Marissa — can you include a brief note in the invite about any logs retention / data residency details you'll cover so we can pre-flag follow-ups to our compliance team?

Thanks — looking forward to the session.
Joe
